title: Jacinta Serafin
description: Liam has had a passion for the field of Family Law since the beginning of his studies, and as a result, he has gained a thorough understanding of the processes surrounding family matters.
html:
Jacinta is currently in her fourth year of university studying a Bachelor of Law/Bachelor of Business (Human Resources) at the University of Technology Sydney. Studying a double degree has provided Jacinta with a variety of skills to assist the Lawyers and Clients at Nolan Lawyers.

Jacinta has a always been interested in Family Law since the commencement of her studies. Jacinta strives to ensure that all clients are understood and emotionally supported during their separation process which can be a challenging time for our clients.
